quest.title: Windblumes and Snowflakes
quest.description: Viktor seems to have run into a small issue during the Windblume Festival.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Mister, are you Fatooey not celebrating the Weedplume Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I, uh, probably won't...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Who, me? Oh, it's you. Come on, why are you giving me that look of suspicion again?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I was just talking to that kid. I wasn't going to do anything bad!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you Fatui really don't celebrate the Windblume Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Wait, what about you? Are you not gonna enjoy the Weedplume Festival either?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Well, I'm sure that Mondstadt's Honorary Knight has a great many duties to attend to during the Windblume Festival. Isn't that right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're looking very smug, what are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Ahem... nothing, nothing. And speaking of nothing, if you haven't got anything else to do, why don't you do me a quick favor?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: This kid's parents have gone out shopping amid the festival, so she's been left here in the care of the sisters.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But as you know, everyone's got their own fair share of business to attend to because of the festivities, even the sisters. They've got no time to play with the girl.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: And that's how she latched on to me. But as you must also surely know, I can't simply leave the Cathedral, so the only thing I can do is talk to her.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: What a shame, that even in this I must withstand the stares of that sister over there...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I'll wager that she's thinking "oh, I wonder what that evil Fatui schemer has in mind this time" or something right about now.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Hmph. So, to get that sister off my back, and for the psychological well-being of this child...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Might our glorious, righteous Honorary Knight deign to take this child out to play?

choices.text: Yeah, yeah, I got your point.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Oh ho, how very straightforward. But then again, you're the Honorary Knight! How silly of me, to think that you might quibble with me for some remuneration...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Come on, just take the kid and go. I'll just be over here, getting a hole drilled into the back of my skull by these sisters...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: *sigh* When will these days finally come to an end?

choices.text: Aw, all you want is for her to go out and have some fun, eh?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: You... Agh, whatever. I'm with the Fatui. We're villains, got it? No bleeding hearts around here.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Just... Go on, shoo. Take that kid and go off to play. She's killing me over here.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: As for me... I'll just be over here, getting a hole drilled into the back of my skull by these sisters...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: *sigh* When will these days finally come to an end?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Why can't that Mister Fatooey go to the Weedplume Festival?

choices.text: He's got important work to do.

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: Impotent work? Even more impotent than the Weedplume Festival?

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: But even if that Fatooey's done a lot of bad, bad things, he can become a good person again if he changes, right?

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: I'm going to tell him that if he becomes a good person, he can take part in the Weedplume Festival!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That man's really busy right now. Let's go out and play first, alright?

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: Oh... okay. Can you take me out to play then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure can, just... not too far out, alright?

choices.text: I don't think Fatui can take part in the Windblume Festival.

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: Why not? Is it because the Fatooey are bad, bad people? Dadda says that they don't brush their teeth before they sleep and eat with their hands...

response.speaker: Lily
response.text: Mm... I guess they are bad people, then. I'm sure that Fatooey's Dadda would be mad, too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About feeding the puppies...

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Ah, Lily, Traveler, you're back. Did you find the puppies?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: We sure did! Thanks, big sis! We had so much fun!

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: That's good. Oh, yes, if the two of you have some time, you could go over to Flora's.

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: It's the Windblume Festival, after all. It would be good to bring a bouquet of flowers back with you, wouldn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Wow... That's true! I wanna go...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Say no more, let's be off!

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Yaaaay! Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Traveler? Is there something you need?

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: And... is that you, Lily? Why are you here? Where are your parents?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: #Dadda and Mommy have something really impotent to do! That's why {F#she's}{M#he's} bringing me around to play!

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Something very important? Ah, Rudolf and Jilliana, they...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Big sis, what happened to those puppies from earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Oh, the puppies? Um, I'm not very sure myself, actually. They usually hide in their kennel and only show up when I put food in their bowl.

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Maybe it's all this noise around us that's driven them out?

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Do you want to play with them, Lily?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Yup! I do! I wanna play with them!

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: Huh... Let me think. I don't think looking for them is going to do us any good... Perhaps you could put some food into that bowl. Let's see if that attracts them.

dialogues.speaker: Blanche
dialogues.text: I think that some Fowl would do the trick best.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Eh? But where are we gonna find some...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can take care of that.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Really? Thank you! Then let's go feed the puppies!

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Yup, that's the wok, alright! Wait for me!

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Gotta stand on a chair... Could you help me get a chair?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Alright, it's done! I've got three pancakes right here. One for you, one for me, and one for Mister Fatooey!

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Alright then, let's go back!

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Come on, puppies, we've got good food...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Wow! They're here, they're here! I wanna pet them...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Aw, they're so soft and fluffy. Mister Fatooey said that he has lots of puppies back home, too!

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: But he said that his puppies are really, really big and really, really furry. I bet they'd be so nice to pet...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: The Windblume Festival... Hmph. It's got nothing to do with me either way.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Hehe. How are you? Here to buy flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Wow, there are so many of them...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Hmm, Lily? Why are you out with the Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: #Dadda and Mommy have something really impotent to do! That's why {F#she's}{M#he's} bringing me around to play!

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Important things, huh? Well, I've certainly got a few ideas about what that might be...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: But never mind that. Do you two need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just here to look at the flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Just here to look, huh? Hmm, how about this. I happen to have a Dandelion with me right now. Here, Lily, this is for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Really? Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That was sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Well, Rudolf has actually ordered a huge bouquet to give to Jilliana...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Giving out one complimentary Dandelion isn't much in comparison.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: This Dandelion's so pwetty... But I gotta go back soon, or Dadda and Mommy are going to worry when they don't see me...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: #Wait. Before we go back... Do you know where we can find a great big wok, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}?

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: I've seen Mommy make pancakes before, and I'd like to make you some too, as thanks for taking me out to play!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Finally back, are you? Great timing, I was just getting tired of that sister looking at me like I colluded with you to do something to Lily...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: But at least that kid's not—

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Mister! Here, this is for you!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: A Dandelion and a pancake? This...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a gift.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: A... a gift? This Dandelion's barely got anything more than its stalk left, and the pancake...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lily made it herself.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: ...It looks... Why, it looks pretty good! Never would have thought that you had it in you, kid...

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Hehe, I learned from Mommy! Once you've eaten it, I wanna hear more of your stories, Mister!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: You still want to hear my...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Alright. Since you've given me a gift, I'll tell you a few more.

dialogues.speaker: Lily
dialogues.text: Hooray! Then I want to hear... about the Fatooey!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: *cough* I... No, it's... Those stories aren't very interesting, you know? I'll think of something better, just you wait!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: You seem to have had lots of fun chatting with that kid. I heard everything too, by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mora for your thoughts?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: They're the dreams of a little child. I've got nothing to say about them either way.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: If the world was so easily divided into good and evil, then many things would...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: ...Whatever. I'll say no more. Go take her out to play.
